## One of the World’s Most Loved Workplaces and a Great Place to Work

For the third year in a row, Funnel has been named one of the world’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces by [The Economist](https://insights.economistenterprise.com/projects/2026-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces). Funnel is also recognized as a Great Place to Work.

## Where Collaboration and Creativity Thrive

At Funnel, we're dedicated to not just building, but also delivering a product that amazes our customers. We believe that collaboration amongst diverse minds isn’t just more enjoyable — it’s crucial for effective innovation. If you thrive in an environment that values experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement, then Funnel is the place for you 💥

We recognize the importance of face-to-face interactions in driving innovation and solving problems. At Funnel, you'll spend at least four days a week in one of our offices, collaborating directly with your team 🌟
